name: NORSOK S-001:2018 Technical safety
subtopics: Technical safety: area classification, fire and gas, ESD, escape, deluge
notes: The Norwegian technical-safety standard behind many WHP safety-system requirements (area classification, fire and gas detection, ESD philosophy, escape and evacuation, deluge). Standards Norway now sells NORSOK standards: standard.no states access is by subscription, collection or single purchase, and no free official download exists (checked 2026-11-27). Third-party copies circulate (silo.tips, pdfcoffee, kupdf) but are unofficial and are not cited here.
